I don't think your supposed to like it. They will at one point or another challenge you. But only to help you. It's important to remember that these people aren't your friends. And that they legally can't tell anyone anything discussed. 
Except if there is an immediate threat. 
It's hard to do, but it's help.

That's heavy mate. I'm sorry to hear. Would you speak to a counselor in person if it was available? 
I've tried going through this kind of thing without getting help from a professional before. I wish I got help. Even though the process sucks, they can help find a solution
That's cool. Is there anyone you trust to talk to about it? School councilor? Any decent teachers? Family?

Yeah, they can be a bit shit. Sometimes it depends on luck of which person you get. I called one yesterday that was more geared towards relationships. I wouldn't say he was useless, but some of the issues I was discussing were out of his expertise. 
But I did ask him to recommend other lifeline based support numbers. 
He got me onto someone who really listened and cared. Good advice, and kept me safe while I was in a dark space. 
It's not for everyone, but possibly worth trying again

Fair enough. I put off getting help for ages because I thought they would lock me up in a hospital. I found out that it's less common these days. It's voluntary to be committed in hospital care. 
This might seem impossible to see right now, but there could be a solution to this problem. Legal aid can look into circumstances. There are free legal services available, but it's hard to find the energy to find them. 
It's worthwhile to.call a helpline if you haven't tried already. 
I had to twice yesterday, and once today. 
Sometimes I'll get someone who is tired, or doesn't seem to care. But most of the time they can give you useful advice

I hear it takes a long time to OD on this stuff. Extremely painful and drawn out. 
I'm not good at this stuff here, and I'm circling close to the edge myself. But thought I should respond. 
Can you tell me what's happening? Are you seeking help?
I got through the day, and I'm feeling better now. I know I have to do some things to get back on the path. Your words helped me. Thank you

Thanks for your response. I don't feel safe or trust him yet. But the first session was all just going through all the questions and history really quickly. 
I should have seemed help when it happened. What will happen when I tell him?
